description: Resource Type definition for EKS CertificateAuthority.

Validity.description: The validity period of the certificate authority.

NotBefore.description: The start of the validity period for the certificate authority.

NotAfter.description: The end of the validity period for the certificate authority.

ScheduledEvents.description: The scheduled auto-activation events for the certificate authority, computed from its validity window.

FirstAutoActivation.description: The earliest date EKS may auto-activate this certificate authority (notAfter minus 6 months).

FinalAutoActivation.description: The deadline by which EKS will auto-activate this certificate authority (notAfter minus 45 days).

ClusterName.description: The name of the EKS cluster that the certificate authority belongs to.

Id.description: The unique identifier of the certificate authority.

CreatedAt.description: The timestamp when the certificate authority was created.

CreatedBy.description: The entity that created the certificate authority.

ActivatedAt.description: The timestamp when the certificate authority was activated.

ActivatedBy.description: The entity that activated the certificate authority.

SigningStatus.description: The signing status of the certificate authority.

DistributionStatus.description: The distribution status of the certificate authority.

Validity.description: The validity period of the certificate authority.

ScheduledEvents.description: The scheduled auto-activation events for the certificate authority.

RollbackAvailable.description: Whether activation of this certificate authority can still be rolled back.

Data.description: The Base64 encoded certificate authority data.
